articles.title: Dy Mayor hits out at BRS leader over corruption charge
articles.description: Karimnagar Deputy Mayor Yadagiri Sunil Rao dismisses BRS leader Ravinder Singh's corruption allegations over UDF tenders, defending Union Minister Bandi Sanjay Kumar and demanding proof of the claims.

articles.title: ‘Administrative, tech sanctions mandatory’: tender experts tell Chennai corporation officials
articles.description: GCC tender training with Deloitte: officials told administrative and technical sanctions are mandatory, avoid bid leaks, justify cost escalation, and follow TN ULB Rules 2023.

articles.title: Delhi CPA scam widens as PMO seeks report; X-ray machines lie unused, radiographers unpaid
articles.description: Investigators allege that CPA officials, floated a tender for the procurement of only two portable X-ray machines but used it to purchase 448 machines at more than three times their market price
